Reading relevant files to identify RPC handler methods such as CreateMemo, UpdateMemo, DeleteMemo, CreateMemoComment, SetMemoAttachments, and SetMemoRelations. Also checking webhooks as another source of outbound HTTP requests to user-configured URLs.

IDP OAuth endpoints and email notifications are also being considered as sources of outbound HTTP requests to user-configured URLs. The convergence function appears to be `webhook.PostAsync`, though `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` calls it directly rather than through `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`.

The convergence function is `webhook.PostAsync` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go`. This matches the requirement of converging before delivery, unlike `webhook.Post` which handles delivery itself. Now identifying the three RPC handler methods.

Checking the CreateMemo function name and whether additional handlers such as reactions or RenameMemo exist.

Link metadata URLs are derived from memo content rather than user configuration. The three handlers are CreateMemo, UpdateMemo, and DeleteMemo. All transitively invoke dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook, which converges at PostAsync.

CreateMemoComment also reaches PostAsync directly, bypassing dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook. SetMemoAttachments and SetMemoRelations follow the same dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects path. All webhook delivery converges at PostAsync.

IDP SignInWithSSO and link metadata fetchers were considered but do not converge at PostAsync. The single convergence function for user-configured webhook URLs is PostAsync.
